signoff.signatureHint: PNG with a transparent background, about 800×300 px.
signoff.stampHint: PNG with a transparent background, about 600×600 px.
signoff.previewFailed: The image could not be loaded
signoff.limits: PNG or JPEG, up to {{max}} MB.
signoff.willBeAdded: Your signature and stamp will be added to this document.
signoff.shareNote: The PDF behind this link includes your signature and stamp if the document was issued with them. Anyone who has the link can see them.

errors.type: Only PNG and JPEG images are accepted
errors.tooLarge: The image is larger than 2 MB
errors.empty: The file is empty. Choose another image.
errors.server: The image could not be saved or loaded because of a server problem. Try again in a moment.
errors.rejected: The image was not accepted. Use a PNG or JPEG from 32 to 4096 px on each side that is not animated.
errors.failed: The change could not be saved. Try again.

unavailable.signature: The document was issued without your signature: the image file is unavailable. Upload it again in Settings → Documents.
unavailable.stamp: The document was issued without your company stamp: the image file is unavailable. Upload it again in Settings → Documents.
unavailable.both: The document was issued without your signature and company stamp: the image files are unavailable. Upload them again in Settings → Documents.

signoff.noteGeneric: Documents that were already issued do not change. The signature and stamp are added only in the designs that support them. A scanned signature or stamp image is not a qualified electronic signature.
signoff.styleUnsupportedGeneric: Your current design ({{style}}) does not add the signature and stamp. Switch to a design that supports them to use them.
signoff.deleteSignatureMessage: New documents will no longer carry it. Documents already issued keep their copy.
signoff.deleteStampMessage: New documents will no longer carry it. Documents already issued keep their copy.

missing.signature: The signature image is missing. New documents will be issued without the signature until you upload it again.
missing.stamp: The stamp image is missing. New documents will be issued without the stamp until you upload it again.
